newsitem.title: USA: Allied Waste Q1 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Allied Waste Q1 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

On December 30, 1996, the company closed its $1.5 billion acquisition of the solid-waste division of Laidlaw Inc. On March 16, 1997, the company sold the Canadian operations purchased in that transaction. The reported amounts for the first quarter of 1997 exclude the results of the Canadian operations because during this period that asset was held for sale. The restated amounts for 1996 have been restated to reflect acquisitions made during 1996 using the pooling-of-interests method of accounting and exclude the results of the Laidlaw operations.
The full company name is Allied Waste Industries Inc.
